hash_definitions: terraform_sha256: go build . at source_git_commit (the provider served to the controller from a filesystem mirror); controller_sha256: crossplane make generate go.build at source_git_commit; runtime_source_sha256: sha256 of git archive --format=tar source_git_commit. Built with go1.25.8 linux/amd64.
harness: scripts/bootstrap-local-stack.sh with ARCHESTRA_VERSION=1.4.0-rc.55, then scripts/bootstrap-crossplane.sh, then scripts/integration/crossplane-lifecycle.py --cases apps --readonly-vault --mcp-url http://provider-mcp-mock.default.svc.cluster.local:19006/mcp.
scope: Four both-scope records against published API 1.4.0-rc.55: App and AppInit in the cluster and namespaced scopes. App covers Secret HTML, environment and MCP server references, browser-permission, environment and sharing clears, versioned content update, content and tool-assignment drift repair, credential-mode and pin clears, explicit lifecycle, orphan, UUID adoption and normal deletion. AppInit covers initProvider Secret HTML at creation, creation-only content after an out-of-band edit, and deletion. AppInit first failed in both scopes because initProvider-only Secret inputs were re-applied on every reconcile; the crossplane fix at source_git_commit makes them creation-only. No other family was re-run on rc.55; earlier Crossplane evidence for them used 1.4.0-rc.49 and different binaries.
